What if you walked barefoot every day?
For most of human history, people walked without shoes. It feels so free. Some runners even switched to barefoot running.

But here's the twist. Your foot muscles can get stronger and your balance may improve, but you risk cuts, fungus and warts, especially in public showers! People with diabetes should never go barefoot, because small cuts can go unnoticed.
